formal_scope: Exact finite-real matrix algebra for the full penalized Hessian action, all cross-group contributions under row accumulation with potentially different coefficient widths, arbitrary coupled penalty blocks, and a concrete counterexample to deleting cross-group data terms.

theorems.name: SuperGLM.coupled_hessian_action
theorems.scope: (X^T W X + S)v = X^T(W(Xv)) + Sv for compatible finite real matrices.

theorems.name: SuperGLM.group_row_accumulation
theorems.scope: For each output group g, X_g^T W sum_h(X_h v_h) = sum_h((X_g^T W X_h)v_h), allowing a different finite coefficient index type for each group.

theorems.name: SuperGLM.group_penalized_row_accumulation
theorems.scope: The group row identity with arbitrary compatible penalty blocks S_gh, retaining their complete finite sum.

theorems.name: SuperGLM.dropping_cross_terms_changes_action
theorems.scope: For X=[1,1], v=[1,1], and identity penalty, the full Gram-plus-penalty action differs from the action obtained after deleting the cross terms.

assumptions: All matrix and vector entries are exact real numbers.
Observation, coefficient and group indices are finite.
The algebraic action and group-sum identities do not require symmetry, positive definiteness or diagonal weights.
not_formalized: Peak memory or a performance improvement.
Floating-point arithmetic or numerical error enclosures.
